The '''Observer Mk. I'''<ref name="ARCore">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a model of [[Surveillance tagger/Legends|surveillance tagger]]<ref name="EECore" /> made by the [[MechBlaze Tracking Corp.]] Cheaper than the other brands of tagger like the [[SureSnoop]], the Observer cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and had a range of one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]].<ref name="CRFG" />
